string-array.item: How do I change the language or turn off music?

string-array.name: faq_answers
string-array.item: Swipe across the letters on the wheel without lifting your finger to connect them into a word. Release to submit it. Fill every box in the grid to finish the level.
Valid words that are not in the grid are bonus words. They add to the ★ counter at the top of the screen.
You receive 500 coins every time you complete a level.
It rearranges the letters on the wheel so you can spot new words. It never changes the solution.
No. Your progress, coins and settings are saved on your device automatically. Pausing, rotating the screen or closing the app will not lose anything.
Open Settings from the Home screen or from the Pause menu.
Please write to support@wordpuzzle.example and describe the problem.

Last updated: November 2026

Word Puzzle respects your privacy.

1. Information we collect
The app does not collect, transmit or sell any personal information. It needs no account and does not request the Internet permission.

2. Data stored on your device
Your level progress, coins, found words and settings (music, sound, language) are stored only on your device. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data removes them.

3. Third parties
The app contains no ads, analytics or third-party tracking tools.

4. Children
The app collects no personal data and is suitable for all ages.

5. Changes
If this policy changes, the updated version will be shown here in the app.

6. Contact
